framework: miles (fork of slime) — SGLang rollout + Megatron/FSDP training
scope: RL only (GRPO). SFT stays on Fireworks, SageMaker, and Prime Intellect.
note: Launch-ready. Reward functions and GoEmotions data built and smoke-tested offline. No training step has run yet on Miles.

orena_sft.note: Not run on Miles. This leg covers RL only.

orena_rl.dataset: data/orena/orena_rl.jsonl (regenerate; 66 MB base64 images, not committed)
orena_rl.note: VLM RL on the exact Fireworks base model. Needs full data regen, VLM generate-function validation, and an 8-GPU node.

goemotions_sft.note: Not run on Miles. This leg covers RL only.

goemotions_rl.note: De-risk leg. FSDP backend, one GPU. Base model differs from Fireworks/SageMaker (Qwen3-0.6B not in Miles catalog).

findings: VLM RL base model is an exact match to Fireworks (Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct) — the only cross-platform pair in the benchmark with the same RL base model.
Text RL base model differs: Qwen3-0.6B is not in Miles' supported list, so GoEmotions RL uses Qwen3-4B.
Compute is self-host and heavy: the standard recipe wants 8x H100/H200/B200; the riley profile has smaller GPU classes (L40S/L4/Blackwell L-series).
Non-binary rewards (dense ORena correctness, Jaccard) hit Miles' documented fractional-reward gradient-noise caveat when a GRPO group shares one reward value.
Reward registration is a single-file --custom-rm-path function, simpler than Fireworks' tarball + Eval Protocol upload.
